sourceVersion: Official APS 2025-26 School Calendar of holidays and breaks web page reviewed August 15, 2026
seoDescription: Akron APS grades 1–12 started Aug. 21, 2025; Pre-K and kindergarten started Aug. 25. See conferences, breaks, office closures, last days, and ICS download.
heroSummary: Akron Public Schools grades 1–12 started Thursday, August 21, 2025. Kindergarten used appointments on August 21 or 22 and a phase-in day August 22; Pre-K and kindergarten began together August 25. Grade 12 finished May 22, 2026, and the final day for students generally was May 28.
heroSourceLine: 2025–26 holidays and breaks · Reviewed against the official APS web calendar
calendarNotes: The firstDay field uses August 21 because that is the first attendance date for grades 1–12. Kindergarten students attended by scheduled appointment on August 21 or 22, August 22 is separately labeled Kindergarten Phase-In, and August 25 is the first day for Pre-K and kindergarten. September 26, November 4, January 16, January 20 and May 5 are staff or records dates with no students. Parent-teacher conferences close school to students October 10 and February 13. Thanksgiving Break is November 26–28, but APS explicitly says offices are open November 26. Winter Break is December 22–January 2, with offices closed only December 24–25, December 31 and January 1. Spring Break is March 30–April 3, with offices closed April 3 for Good Friday. Grade 12 finishes May 22, six calendar days before the May 28 final day for students generally.

customSections.content: August 21 is not a universal first full day. Kindergarten families needed a school-scheduled appointment before the first full Pre-K and kindergarten date.

customSections.label: Student Breaks and Office Closures Do Not Fully Match
customSections.content: Students are out throughout each break range, but APS identifies narrower office availability. Thanksgiving offices remain open November 26; Winter Break office closures occur on four named holidays; and Spring Break closes offices on Good Friday only.

customSections.label: The Official 2025–26 Source Is a Web Page
customSections.content: APS publishes this archived list as HTML rather than a downloadable annual PDF. The official web page is therefore the canonical source, and this page does not show a PDF download button.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Akron Public Schools start in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–12 started Thursday, August 21, 2025. Kindergarten used appointments August 21 or 22 and a phase-in date August 22; Pre-K and kindergarten began August 25.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Akron APS Thanksgiving Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Schools were closed November 26–28, 2025. APS specifically says district offices were open Wednesday, November 26.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Akron APS Winter Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break ran December 22, 2025 through January 2, 2026. Offices closed December 24–25, December 31 and January 1 rather than for the full student break.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Akron APS Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break ran Monday, March 30 through Friday, April 3, 2026. District offices closed April 3 for Good Friday.

calendarFaqs.q: When was the last day for Akron APS seniors in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The final day for grade 12 was Friday, May 22, 2026. The final day for students generally was Thursday, May 28.

calendarFaqs.q: Is there an official Akron APS 2025–26 calendar PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: Not on the official archive supplied for this year. APS publishes the reviewed holidays-and-breaks list as a web page, so that page is the canonical source here.
